ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Finance, Actuarial Science, 1st Stage Accountancy, and Agri-Finance majors thru Nov 28. (Dual degree students who are declared Accountancy will NOT receive registration priority.) Any remaining seats will open to other College of Business students at approximately noon on Monday, Nov. 29. Prerequisite (FIN 221) will be enforced. Students who have not completed FIN 221 will be removed from FIN 300.
